format: HTML with embedded JavaScript and CSS
description: This file is a web-based user interface for a database visualization tool. It provides a frontend for browsing databases, tables, and data, with interactive elements for refreshing data, selecting databases and tables, and viewing data details. The embedded JavaScript handles fetching data from API endpoints, rendering tables, and managing UI interactions.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from the API and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list by re-fetching data from the API.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles display of tables for a selected database and loads tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a given database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders table data into HTML, managing wide content and formatting.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual data cell with appropriate formatting, handling objects, nulls, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long strings or objects.
